remarks: Experience modern living in this newly renovated, sun-filled three-bedroom residence, ideally situated in the heart of midtown Stamford. This spacious apartment features gleaming hardwood floors throughout and boasts an abundance of natural light in every room. The kitchen is equipped with brand-new appliances, offering both style and functionality for everyday living.  Enjoy access to a shared backyard-perfect for relaxing, convenient street parking on a quiet, one-way street. The location is unbeatable: just a short walk to Stamford's vibrant dining, shopping, and entertainment options, with easy access to major highways for effortless commuting. Landlord is requiring credit to be at 685+.
